title: SOMC@Periodic Mesoporous Silica Nanoparticles: Meerwein–Ponndorf–Verley Reduction Promoted by Immobilized Rare-Earth-Metal Alkoxides

material_class.structural_family: homoleptic Ce(IV) isopropoxide trimer with μ3- and μ2-alkoxide bridges

synthesis.procedure: Ce[N(SiHMe2)2]4 (291.3 mg, 0.435 mmol) was dissolved in n-hexane (5 mL). iPrOH (105.5 mg, 1.755 mmol, 4.03 equiv) in n-hexane (5 mL) was added dropwise, producing a color change from deep red to translucent yellow. Alternatively, a slight excess of iPrOH (6–8 equiv) in n-hexane was added until no further color change was observed. The mixture was stirred for 15 min, the solvent was removed in vacuo, and the crude product was recrystallized from C6H4F2 to give blocky yellow crystals of 1 (159.8 mg, 0.141 mmol, 98%).

reagents.name: isopropyl alcohol
reagents.amount: 105.5 mg, 1.755 mmol, 4.03 equiv (or 6–8 equiv in the alternative protocol)

synthesis.vessel_or_method: silylamine elimination / alcoholysis followed by recrystallization
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: solvent removed in vacuo; recrystallized from C6H4F2 to give blocky yellow crystals

properties.summary: Evans-method solution magnetometry of 1 in C6D6 at 299 K gives a small effective moment (μeff = 0.70 μB; χmolT = 0.23 emu K mol−1), consistent with essentially diamagnetic Ce(IV) with a minor paramagnetic contribution.

measurements.name: χmol
measurements.conditions: Evans method, C6D6, 400.16 MHz, 299 K, c = 0.0148 mol L-1, Δ = 3.8 Hz

material_class.structural_family: putative homoleptic Ce(III) isopropoxide (poorly soluble powder; no SCXRD)

synthesis.procedure: Ce[N(SiMe3)2]3 (137.4 mg, 0.221 mmol) was dissolved in n-hexane (5 mL) and an excess of iPrOH (10 drops, ca. 100 mg, ca. 1.7 mmol, ca. 8 equiv) was added. The mixture was briefly shaken; the yellow solution discolored and a slightly greenish white precipitate formed. Solvents and liberated HN(SiMe3)2 were removed in vacuo to give 58.5 mg (0.184 mmol, 83%) of [Ce(OiPr)3] as a slightly off-white powder.

reagents.name: isopropyl alcohol
reagents.amount: 10 drops, ca. 100 mg, ca. 1.7 mmol, ca. 8 equiv

synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: solvents and HN(SiMe3)2 removed in vacuo; isolated as a slightly off-white powder (no single-crystal recrystallization reported)

source_locations.location: Experimental Section, [Ce(OiPr)3]; Anal. Calcd for C9H21CeO3
